THIS CRL.RP IS FILED U/S. 397 R/W 401 CR.P.C BY THE ADVOCATE FOR THE PETITIONER PRAYING THAT THIS HONBLE COURT MAY BE PLEASED TO SET ASIDE THE ORDER DATED 19.11.2025 IN SPL.C NO.967/2022 BY THE HONBLE IX ADDL.DISTRICT AND SESSIONS JUDGE, BENGALURU RURAL DISTRICT, BENGALURU THEREBY DISMISSED THE APPLICATION U/S 227 OF CRPC FILED BY THE PETITIONERS AND CONSEQUENTLY PASSED THE ORDER THEREBY DISCHARGE THE PETITIONER WHO IS ARRAYED AS ACCUSED NO.7 AND ACCUSED NO.14 FROM ALL CHARGES LEVELLED AGAINST THEM U/S 109, 409, 420, 421, 423, 424, 465, 467,
468, 471, 120(B) R/W 34 OF IPC AND SECTION 8 AND 12 PREVENTION OF CORRUPTION ACT 1988.
